It also asks June to confirm the name and label and help clean up the saved report and the shorthand. I signed it from you, so change that if you'd rather it came from Sofia.

I posted the same summary as a reply under your message in #coastal-team. June is inside pemberline.com and the draft has no finance figures, so it needed no approval.
